system.description:
You reach past a beast's eyes and into its mind, immersing yourself wholly in its thoughts and feelings — a raw, intimate experience for both of you as two souls briefly touch.

By touching an animal, spending a Willpower Trait and winning a Mental Challenge, you make contact with its mind; a Simple Test per memory then lets you read one memory at a time, with failure breaking the contact. Alternatively, spending a full minute and a second Willpower Trait plus another Mental Challenge forges a lasting bond that grants at-will access to all the animal's memories without further contact until you choose to end it — failing the ongoing Simple Test merely delays you a turn. Prolonged bonding risks the animal's behavior patterns bleeding into you. Retest with Animal Ken.
